accepted.sentence: Some designs have rounded front corners, reducing sharp exposed edges along the sides of projecting horizontal supports.
Tempered glass panels can serve as transparent supports, allowing light through while displaying objects above and below.
Small swivel casters fitted beneath the base allow a loaded unit to roll across smooth floors.
An integrated LED strip beneath an upper panel can illuminate the level below without requiring a separate lamp.
Open wire-grid supports leave gaps between metal strands, permitting air circulation and visibility through each level.
Decorative crown molding may cap the upper edge, adding a projecting profile beyond the main frame.
Leveling feet can be threaded at the base corners to compensate for uneven flooring and reduce rocking.
A recessed notch along the lower rear edge can clear a wall's projecting baseboard.
